references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, instructions are given for the cleansing of the Levites to prepare them for service
Aaron shall wave the Levites as a wave offering before the Lord's face, which directly corresponds to תְּנוּפָה in verse 15
Summarizes that the Levites were cleansed and waved as a wave offering, after which they began their service in the tent of meeting
Describes the Levites' responsibility for the tabernacle and its equipment, which is the service they are consecrated to perform
The Levites are given to Aaron and his sons to perform service at the tent of meeting
Specifies the age limit for Levites who are to do work in the tent of meeting (אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד)
The wave offering (תְּנוּפָה) at the consecration of the priests, the same ritual action used for the Levites
Moses waves parts of the consecration offering as a wave offering, a parallel ritual to the consecration of the Levites
